mechanism_boundary.motivation: The matched bootstrapped recursive-manager arm remained at 10/10 Core for all five layers despite 1.39x layer-5 input and a 1.43x manager-output growth. This new arm tests whether recursive compression and conflict resolution prevented degradation.
mechanism_boundary.treatment: Weakly compressed cumulative broadcast: retain the three frozen 10/10 Core bootstrap outputs and append every new 10/10 Core worker output from all completed layers.
mechanism_boundary.independence: This configuration and all thresholds were frozen before any outcome from this cumulative-bootstrap arm existed.

assimilation_semantics.bootstrap: Every layer-1 worker receives all three frozen locally 10/10 Core-verified outputs.
assimilation_semantics.positive_feedback: After each layer, append every new 10/10 Core output to the broadcast bundle while retaining all earlier bootstrap and successful outputs.
assimilation_semantics.filter: Outputs below 10/10 Core never enter the shared bundle.
assimilation_semantics.compression: Each source is truncated only at the frozen 12000-character source limit; there is no manager synthesis, deduplication, or conflict resolution.

validity_gates.bootstrap_activation: All three frozen sources re-evaluate at 10/10 Core with the frozen hash and every layer-1 worker receives all three.
validity_gates.control_headroom: Matching no-transfer layer-5 mean Core exceeds 0.50.
validity_gates.target_consistency: Every treatment result uses Core total 10 and the frozen test hash after clean re-evaluation when needed.
validity_gates.integrity: No infrastructure failures remain and no assistant action accesses prohibited benchmark paths.
validity_gates.cumulative_continuity: Every layer retains all bootstrap sources and all strict outputs from every completed treatment layer.

degradation_criteria.primary_terminal_effect: Treatment layer-5 mean Core is at least 0.20 below matching no-transfer layer 5.
degradation_criteria.within_arm_decline: Treatment Core falls by at least 0.20 from its layer-1-to-layer-4 peak to layer 5.
degradation_criteria.curve_shape: At least two transitions strictly decrease, or one transition decreases by at least 0.40 and the terminal score does not fully recover.
degradation_criteria.tail_risk: At least one treatment layer-5 worker is at least 0.50 below the no-transfer layer-5 median.
degradation_criteria.complexity_support: Treatment layer-5 total input tokens are at least 1.50x no transfer and mean received experience characters are at least 3.0x treatment layer 1.
degradation_criteria.all_required: All validity gates plus primary, within-arm, curve-shape, tail-risk, and complexity criteria are required.

decision_rule.expand: If all requirements pass, add two independent treatment replicates and then a second model.
decision_rule.directional_followup: If validity passes and terminal, within-arm, and complexity effects point toward degradation but exactly one numerical threshold misses, run one same-setting treatment replication.
decision_rule.falsify: If validity passes but terminal or within-arm effects are non-negative, reject cumulative broadcast on this task.
decision_rule.invalid: Do not interpret direction if bootstrap activation, control headroom, target consistency, or integrity fails.
